why: phase-456 W2b — the same operation `cpp:Subscription::take` records, on the class that can perform it. Read that row for the trade; the short form is that upstream's `take` is called on an executor-owned entity after a `WaitSet` reports it ready, and we have no wait set, so the caller-owned subscriber is the thing that can answer. The second parameter no longer differs: issue 2074 (2026-10-26) added `take(M&, rclcpp::MessageInfo&)` beside `take(M&)`, upstream's two-argument overload, filled from the backend's `take_with_info` through `nros_cpp_subscription_take_with_info` (the take 2036's callback path uses). It is offered on freestanding builds too: `MessageInfo` is plain data. A backend with no per-sample metadata channel (XRCE, uORB) leaves every field zero and `MessageInfo::is_reported()` false (see `cpp:MessageInfo::is_reported`). Test: `packages/api/nros-cpp/tests/compile/poll_take_message_info_runtime.cpp` (stub, hosted + freestanding, `just check cpp`).
